description: This file defines a test double class FakeCalendarProviderRegistry used for unit testing. It provides mocked responses for calendar provider registry behavior, including provider registration, retrieval of auth methods, and source types. The class extends CalendarProviderRegistry and includes methods for adding providers, fetching auth methods, retrieving source types, and resetting configuration.

classes.name: FakeCalendarProviderRegistry
classes.description: A test double class that simulates calendar provider registry behavior for testing purposes, providing pre-configured providers and mock responses.

methods.name: addProvider
methods.description: Adds or updates a provider source with a specified authentication method in the registry.

methods.name: getAuthMethodForSource
methods.description: Returns the authentication method for a given source, or null if not found.

methods.name: getProviderForAccount
methods.description: Retrieves the provider instance associated with a calendar account; always returns null in this stub.

methods.name: getCalendarSourceTypes
methods.description: Returns an array of available calendar source types with key-value pairs.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the provider registry to its initial configuration.
